title: Civic Action Scorecard Planner
homeIntro: The Civic Action Scorecard is Miami Dade College's menu of 109 civic actions, each worth points. Reach Bronze (100), Silver (200), or Gold (300); awards are granted by iCED through the Changemaker Hub once you submit your documentation there.

phases.name: Start
phases.tagline: Get informed and registered: online, under an hour each
phases.why: Everything here can be done from a phone or laptop in under an hour, so you can get informed, registered, and moving before committing to anything bigger.

phases.name: Bronze
phases.tagline: Show up: one-off visits, contacts, donations, one-hour events
phases.why: Once you know the landscape, these one-off visits, contacts, donations, and one-hour events turn what you learned into showing up.

phases.name: Silver
phases.tagline: Commit: week-long habits, 5-hour service, memberships, certifications, day-long trainings, a book
phases.why: With Bronze behind you, these longer commitments build real depth: habits kept for a week, five hours of service, memberships, trainings, and a book.

phases.name: Gold
phases.tagline: Lead and build: speeches, poll work, leadership programs, hosting, presenting, projects
phases.why: By now you have the experience to lead: give the speech, work the polls, host the drive, present the project you built.

credit: Built by Daniel Llobet (School for Advanced Studies, MDC Wolfson) as a student project. Questions about the scorecard itself go to iCED at iCED@mdc.edu.
privacy: If you sign in, your progress is stored in a Firebase project owned by Daniel Llobet on Google Cloud. Only you can read it. Delete it any time from the account menu. This is not an MDC or iCED system.

disclaimer: This planner is an unofficial planning tool, not an MDC or iCED system, and it does not submit anything on your behalf. Progress is stored only in your browser until you export it.
